'''Josef Stoer''' (born 21 June 1934) is a German mathematician specializing in [[numerical analysis]] and [[professor emeritus]] of the Institut für Mathematik of [[Universität Würzburg]].<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.mathematik.uni-wuerzburg.de/personal/stoer.html | title=Institut für Mathematik | access-date=2013-05-06 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150601235825/http://www.mathematik.uni-wuerzburg.de/personal/stoer.html | archive-date=2015-06-01 | url-status=dead }}</ref>

Stoer was born in [[Meschede]], and earned his Ph.D. in 1961 at [[Johannes Gutenberg-Universität Mainz]] under [[Friedrich Ludwig Bauer]] and [[Klaus Samelson]]. He has advised over 20 doctoral students.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|21622}}</ref>

He is the author (with [[Roland Bulirsch]]) of ''Introduction to Numerical Analysis'', a standard reference for the theory of [[numerical methods]].<ref>Reviews of ''Introduction to Numerical Analysis'':
* Carl-Erik Fröberg (1981, 1994), ''Mathematics of Computation'', {{jstor|2007454}}, {{jstor|2153586}}
* J. Thomas King (1982), ''SIAM Review'', {{jstor|2029454}}
* L.Berg (1993), {{zbl|0771.65002}}
* Martin Buhmann (1995), ''The Mathematical Gazette'', {{jstor|3620125}}
* David R. Hill (1995), {{MR|1295246}}
* A. Akutowicz (2002), {{zbl|1004.65001}}
* Gerry Leversha (2004), ''The Mathematical Gazette'', {{jstor|3620937}}
</ref> He has an honorary doctorate from the University of Augsburg (2007) and the [[Technical University of Munich]] (1997)<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.in.tum.de/en/research/honorary-doctors.html | title=Fakultät für Informatik: Honorary Doctors| date=14 July 2023}}</ref> and is a member of the Bavarian Academy of Sciences (1981).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://link.springer.com/journal/211/68/1/page/1#|title = Numerische Mathematik, Volume 68, Issue 1 - Springer}}</ref> The [[Bulirsch–Stoer algorithm]] is named after him and [[Roland Bulirsch]].<ref>{{cite journal
 | last = Monroe | first = James L.
 | date = June 2002
 | doi = 10.1103/physreve.65.066116
 | issue = 6
 | journal = Physical Review E
 | title = Extrapolation and the Bulirsch–Stoer algorithm
 | volume = 65}}</ref>
